items.title: Alphabet 財報不如預期，這首次真正表明人工智慧正在蠶食搜尋業務。
items.titleEn: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
items.titleZh: Alphabet 財報不如預期，這首次真正表明人工智慧正在蠶食搜尋業務。
items.summaryEn: Wall Street hammered Alphabet for an earnings miss that included weaker-than-expected revenue out of the company's core business.
items.summaryZh: 由於Alphabet的獲利不如預期，包括其核心業務收入低於預期，華爾街對其進行了猛烈抨擊。

items.summaryEn: Markets are pricing in less than a 10% chance that the FOMC follows up its quarter--point hike in September with another increase.
items.summaryZh: 市場預期，聯準會在9月升息25個基點後再次升息的可能性不到10%。

items.titleZh: CNBC的調查揭示了民主黨和共和黨人最害怕對方的什麼。
items.summaryEn: The economy is still a key issue in the 2026 election, but voters are concerned about Trump testing the bounds of the office and Democratic Socialist polices.
items.summaryZh: 經濟仍然是 2026 年大選的關鍵議題，但選民擔心川普會試探總統權力的界限，並推行民主社會主義政策。
